name: siprocom-sgs
description: SIPROCOM — Système de Gestion de Stock

scripts._comment:dev:client: Prisma takes ~10s to load on Windows while Vite is ready in ~1s. Without this wait the browser opens onto proxy 502s and looks broken.
scripts.dev:client: wait-on -t 90000 tcp:127.0.0.1:4000 && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix server exec -- prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: npm --prefix server exec -- prisma migrate reset --force && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test:stock && npm run test:ui
scripts.check: npm run i18n:check && npm run build && npm run test
